caption: The drawing features a single tall vase with a flared rim and a slightly wider base, rendered in shades of turquoise and blue-green. The surface of the vase is decorated with a pattern consisting of sweeping, curved lines and loops in red and beige, crossing diagonally and creating a sense of movement on the vase’s body. The vase is placed against a plain beige background. There are thin brown lines forming a right angle and a horizontal base beneath and behind the vase, suggesting a spatial reference or a tabletop edge. The overall composition centers the vase, with a soft shadow falling to the lower right. The bottom right corner of the drawing includes the text “DIMLING” written in a small font.
title: Vase (Green with Red Swirl)
